    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        a = list(map(int, input[index:index + n]))
        index += n
        max_val = max(a)
        min_val = min(a)
        results.append(str(n * abs(max_val - min_val)))
    print("\n".join(results))
